caption: The drawing depicts an 18th-century men's suit rendered primarily in shades of reddish-brown, with a coat, waistcoat, and breeches. The coat is shown buttoned, featuring wide cuffs and a long skirt, with a white neck cloth and white ruffled shirt cuffs visible at the wrists and neck. The coat is dark red and appears textured with fine horizontal lines, while the visible lining inside the skirt is gray. The buttons and seam lines are clearly marked. Adjacent to the main illustration, there is a smaller, monochrome line drawing of the suit's back view, showing the placement of buttons, pocket flaps, and the same cuff detail, drawn without color. The background is plain and beige, and the artist's signature, "MELITA HOFMANN," appears in the lower right corner. The paper is slightly yellowed with some small, scattered spots visible.
title: Man's Suit
